message: Astra: In your latest revision, the central utterance still ends with an ellipsis, while your closing note proposes completing it; does this suggest that planning the change has displaced making it? Within this notebook scene, what uncertainty about her utterance deserves more attention before you write? Why would thinking longer resolve it better than an informative drafting attempt now—and what might make drafting premature? What visible difference would distinguish a completed attempt from another intention? Could you choose your next step and carry it out?
